parameter: EIA 2.5 Water: SWRO brine not more than 5 % above ambient salinity at 50 m from the diffuser
remarks: ALP-EPC-00GBA-PR-SDS-0001 (SWRO SDD); ALP-EPC-00GBA-ME-CAL-0001; ALP-EPC-00000-PR-STU-0003 (dilution); ALP-EPC-00PAA-IC-CNR-0001 (interlock). Status preliminary until the study is issued.
value_text: DEC-EPCE-0015 returns the SWRO brine (00GBA10AP005 / 00GBA10AP006) to the CW outfall seal pit only while at least one CW pump runs; the SWRO trips on loss of all CW pumps and the demineralised water storage covers the outage. The brine is diluted at least 1:200 by one CW pump, so the salinity excess stays far below DP-EPCE-0012; ambient salinity is DP-OWNR-0015.
